notes: Mopar diagrams carry no area field in catalog.json, so area is null unless a CUORE element sources a zone (area then copied from it). Part numbers deliberately omitted. MES ref 'MODULE/(module)' means the module appears in the parsed MES module list (no parameter). Washer pump, rear window heater and starter relay are named only by CUORE fuse labels (fuses_stelvio_2018.json); those fuse ids appear as cuore_element sources. Merges made on name equivalence: PAM=Park Assist Module, HVAC module=Mopar 'Power Module' in the A/C unit diagram (weakest merge), IPC=Instrument Panel Cluster. Not merged: Passive Entry Module vs RFHUB, Power Transfer Unit Control Module vs DTCM, Collision Module vs DASM, Steering Column Module vs CSWM (not proven the same). window_riser_circuit not tied to the rear window motors (the circuit's window is not sourced). Mopar Parts lists generic fuses/relays (J Case, Maxi, Mini, Micro relay) not itemised here. ABS, BCM, TCM etc. other than ECM and IPC have zero parsed MES parameters, so no switches/actuators from them. Mopar items are catalogue parts, not proof the car is so equipped.
